text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's composition proves nothing. All-female panels occur routinely in firms with women in HR and senior management, and research doesn't show same-sex panels reliably favour their own sex. Raising it would read as an accusation built on arithmetic, and would likely harden attitudes toward you.

The substance is also weaker than it feels. A group-head role weights client-winning, commercial judgement and people management — not years at the drawing board. "Excellent client relationships" may be exactly what they were buying, and your fifteen years and three projects don't automatically beat that.

Do chase the written explanation, politely and in writing, citing your earlier request. If the reasons given are evasive or shift, reassess then.
